items.heading: Each Row Is One Real
items.text: Each row is one real notice. The next notice will differ, so treat these as a picture of how each exam looks, not a promise.

items.heading: The Order Follows How Much
items.text: The order follows how much you can build beside or after the job, then the pay ceiling. It is not the order of exam difficulty. The ratings are judgement, not statistics.

items.text: UPSC mains: a History optional that overlaps with the history and culture parts of General Studies, plus essay and long-answer writing.

items.heading: State Psc Papers
items.text: State PSC papers: state history, culture and polity are part of General Studies, and the interview rewards a clear, reasoned answer.
